description: Na₆Mg(NiO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.43 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.67 Å. Mg is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.97 Å) and two longer (2.12 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. Ni is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.06 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na, one Mg, and one Ni atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅MgNi pentagonal bipyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Ni atoms.
